shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json && git log --oneline | head && find . -type f -not -path './node_modules/*' -not -path './.git/*' | head -100

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore __agent_eval__/run.mjs; echo ---; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | head -40; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ 2>/dev/null; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme; cat $D/ThemeProvider.d.ts $D/types.d.ts $D/useTheme.d.ts $D/useThemeType.d.ts $D/useThemeValue.d.ts $D/useThemeSettings.d.ts $D/ThemeContext.d.ts $D/ThemeSettingsContext.d.ts $D/constants.d.ts $D/useSystemTheme.d.ts; echo ---PROVIDER-JS---; cat $D/ThemeProvider.js; echo ---; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ ; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ | grep -iE 'switch|segment|radio|button|icon' ; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts 2>/dev/null; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -60; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Icon/Icon.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Icon/types.d.ts

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | grep -E '"version"|"name"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | grep -iE '^(Sun|Moon|Display|Monitor)' ; grep -n '"@gravity-ui/icons"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json; grep -rn 'RadioButton\b' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts | head; grep -n 'theme\|SegmentedRadioGroup\|Switch' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts

timeout 20 npm view @gravity-ui/uikit version dist-tags 2>&1 | tail -5; echo ---; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | sed -n 1,80p; echo ---; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroupOption.d.ts; echo ---; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/hooks/ | head -40; grep -n "deprecated" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/*.d.ts

grep -nE 'Flex|Card|Text|Label' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/index.d.ts | head; echo ---ICONS---; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/Sun.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | grep -A3 '"exports"' | head; echo ---V8---; mkdir -p /tmp/uikit8 && cd /tmp/uikit8 && timeout 90 npm pack @gravity-ui/uikit@8.0.0 --silent 2>&1 | tail -1 && tar xzf gravity-ui-uikit-8.0.0.tgz && cat package/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts package/build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts package/build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts && grep -E '"react"|"@gravity-ui/icons"' package/package.json && ls package/build/esm/components | grep -iE 'segmented|switch|radiobutton'
rm -rf dist && (which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/.bin | grep -iE 'playwright|puppeteer'; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null) ; echo "browser-check-done"
